ios.desc:
Simplify Love and Finances with Couples Expense Tracker

Experience a better way to manage money together. Couples Expense Tracker makes shared finances easy so you and your partner can focus on what really matters, your life together.

Why Couples Love This App:

• Effortless Expense Tracking: Organize and store all your bills and shared expenses securely in the cloud, accessible anytime.

• Hub Sharing: Share access to your Hub with your partner so you can manage your budget as a team.

• Dynamic Expense Splitting: Split costs fairly based on each partner’s income. The app automatically calculates everyone’s share as your income changes, making joint budgeting smooth and stress free.

• Insightful Budget Analytics: Visualize spending trends, monitor monthly expenses, and stay informed with beautiful charts that make understanding your finances simple.

• Net Worth Overview: Track assets, debts, and savings goals to get a clear picture of your combined net worth.

• Customizable Security: Keep your financial data safe with Face or Touch ID. 

• Personal Touches: Set user names, choose your currency, and personalize your financial dashboard for a seamless experience.

• Collaborate in Real Time: Securely sync and back up your data with iCloud so you're up to date, no matter the device.

• Easy Data Export: Download your expenses as a CSV file for offline use or easy sharing.

Start your free trial today and unlock the full power of Couples Expense Tracker, including premium insights and unlimited cloud backup. Cancel anytime.

Take the guesswork and stress out of managing your shared finances. Download Couples Expense Tracker now and start building a smarter financial future, together.
